title: Suspension Pike
summary: A pike from a push-up position with your feet in suspension straps, for the abs.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.2 for obliques: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Get into a plank with your feet in the foot cradles.
Lift your hips high and pull your feet toward your hands with straight legs.

form_cues.cue: Lift the hips toward the ceiling
Lead with your hips, not your knees.

mistakes.text: Bending the knees instead of piking.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
